title: Add Waffle Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: Allocating exactly 100 grid cells proportionally across categories requires the largest-remainder rounding method (assign floor(percent), then distribute leftover cells to the largest fractional remainders) — a well-defined algorithm, but with no existing precedent anywhere in this codebase to copy. Recomputing the full grid when a category is toggled off via the legend is a genuine interaction design decision (redistribute the removed category's cells vs. leave gaps), not a repeat of an existing pattern.

summary: A category/value mark allocating a fixed 10×10 grid of cells proportionally across categories using the largest-remainder method, with per-category colors that stay stable across legend toggling and a grid that recomputes when a category is hidden.
requirements: Accepts `category` and `value` channels; allocates a fixed 10×10 (100-cell) grid proportionally by value share using the largest-remainder rounding method so cell counts always sum to exactly 100
Each category's assigned color must stay the same regardless of which other categories are currently shown/hidden via the legend (no color reassignment on toggle)
Hiding a category via the legend removes its cells and recomputes the grid allocation across the remaining visible categories so the grid still totals 100 cells
Cells fill in a defined order (e.g. row-major) so the visual grouping per category is contiguous, not scattered

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: All 100 cells allocated to that one category.

edgeCases.case: A category with a value share below 1%
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: May round to zero allocated cells under floor(percent); largest-remainder distribution should still give it a chance at a leftover cell if its remainder is large relative to others, but a category can legitimately end up with 0 cells — document this as expected, not a bug.
Render the empty-data state (or an explicit 'nothing to show' variant) rather than an empty grid with no explanation.

edgeCases.case: Toggling a category back on after hiding it
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Grid recomputes again including that category, using its original color (colors are stable, keyed by category identity, not by visibility).
Same categorical overflow behavior as Bar/Donut's existing color handling.
Cell fill colors resolve through the existing colorScheme-aware color scale.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.

crossCutting.notes: touchesLegendInteraction: legend clicking must both hide the category's cells and trigger a full grid recompute (largest-remainder reallocation), which is a new behavior beyond the existing legendHighlightSignals opacity-toggle pattern — this needs a data-level recompute, not just an opacity encode. requiresNewSignalOrScale: true — a `hiddenCategories` signal (set/cleared by legend clicks) feeding the reallocation transform, plus the categorical color scale keyed by category (stable regardless of hiddenCategories, per requirements). requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.

implementationPlan.change: Create WaffleOptions/WaffleOptionsWithDefaults/WaffleSpecOptions with required `category`/`value` fields and a `gridSize` option (default 10x10).
Add WaffleOptions to the MarkOptions union.

New: allocateLargestRemainderCells (pure function computing per-category cell counts from value shares, respecting a hiddenCategories signal input), expandToGridCells (transform expanding per-category counts into 100 individual cell rows with row/col coordinates) — no existing util to reuse.
getWaffleMark building a rect mark per cell keyed by row/col grid position.
addWaffle, addData (calls the new allocation/expansion helpers), addSignals (hiddenCategories signal + interactive-mark signals), setScales (categorical color scale keyed by category).
Unit tests for allocateLargestRemainderCells covering exact-100 totals, zero-allocation categories, and single-category cases.
Unit tests for getWaffleMark using the fixture.
Per-function tests for addData/addSignals/setScales, including the hiddenCategories recompute path.
Register waffleCount: -1 in initializeComponentCounts, import addWaffle, add the 'waffle' switch case.
WaffleProps/WaffleElement, Omit-ing only fields replaced at the React boundary (ChartTooltip/ChartPopover children).
Render-null component holding prop defaults, placed under rc/ per the Donut/BigNumber rc-status precedent.
Import Waffle from '../rc' and add its displayName dispatch case.
Add Waffle to the sanitizeRscChartChildren import/list from '../rc'.
Update the toStrictEqual ChartOptions snapshot to include the new mark type at default values.
Basic story plus a LegendToggle interaction story demonstrating grid recompute.

openQuestions: Is the 10x10 grid size fixed, or should gridSize be configurable (e.g. for a 5x20 layout)? Confirm before treating gridSize as a real prop vs. an internal constant.
Cell fill order (row-major left-to-right-top-to-bottom vs. column-major vs. serpentine) isn't specified by the gathered material and needs a design decision.
